items.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
items.description: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

items.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
items.description: State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel.

items.title: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution
items.description: Pike's lawyers said the failure "goes far beyond any one person". Pike is in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections.

items.title: Cornell president says university 'must do better' after frat house rape allegations
items.description: Michael Kotlikoff described the allegations of a woman who says she was drugged and gang raped as "deeply disturbing".

items.title: 'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis
items.description: More than 50 protests took place on Saturday after the government failed to get emergency legislation through parliament.

items.title: What to know about Brazil's election pitting Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro
items.description: Polls suggest the election will be a closely run contest between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing rival.

items.title: Debris found from plane that went missing off US coast
items.description: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.

items.title: US father and son arrested after 'gas station heroin' deaths
items.description: They are accused of selling at least one student derivatives of kratom, often called "gas station heroin" in the US.

items.title: UK-Iranian dual national bailed after RAF Fairford incident arrest
items.description: The 25-year-old man was arrested in the London borough of Westminster on Thursday.

items.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
items.description: The co-ordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.

items.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
items.description: About 735 schools have faced disruption as violent protests over standards and lack of teachers continue.

items.title: Kim wins Asian Games gold to secure military exemption
items.description: Golfer Tom Kim wins gold at the Asian Games to secure an exemption from mandatory service in South Korea's military.

items.title: Why Canada is preparing for a (long shot) US invasion
items.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney has said the military is running scenarios in the unlikely case the US invades Canada.

items.title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer
items.description: Ghana is a predominantly Christian country where preaching on public transport is widespread.

items.title: Could El Niño mean there are no Atlantic hurricanes this year?
items.description: For the first time in three decades there has not been a single Atlantic hurricane in September, normally the most active month.

items.title: Joker persona helps Cong 'feel the fear' in opponents
items.description: Wang Cong dismisses critics who say she is not deserving of facing Natalia Silva for the flyweight world title at UFC 332 on Saturday.

items.title: Rare tornado whips through small Australian town
items.description: The twister was caught on camera in Ulladulla, New South Wales, damaging property and downing trees.

items.title: Why has Brazil accused the US of election interference?
items.description: The Latin American country will vote for its next president, as Lula da Silva and Bolsonaro clash over sovereignty, security and ties with Washington.

items.title: Will Spain's housing crisis lead to a snap election?
items.description: The BBC's Guy Hedgecoe is in Madrid, where a series of marches have been scheduled, after Spain's Congress rejected measures aimed at tackling the country's housing crisis.

items.title: Newly released video shows Luigi Mangione’s arrest
items.description: The bodycam footage also shows a police officer finding a gun in Mangione's backpack, days after the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.
